title: Common primitives (v1)
description: Shared definitions for requirement / variant / optimizer schemas. Structural only: per-field ranges, patterns and cross-field invariants that must hold for both the Go core and the ML service. The canonical reason-code enum lives in contracts/openapi.yaml#/components/schemas/ReasonCode; here it is validated by pattern to avoid a third copy.

Identifier.description: Prefixed pseudonym: emp_*, brf_*, req_*, run_*, var_*, prj_*, abs_*, asg_*, aud_*, exp_*, unt_*.

ReasonCode.description: One of the codes enumerated in contracts/openapi.yaml (UI<->Go) and contracts/ml-openapi.yaml (Go<->ML).

EvidenceSpan.description: quote is authoritative and must occur literally in the brief text; char_start/char_end are optional code-point offsets that, if present, must match the located position.

EffortRange.description: Three-point estimate. Ordering min <= likely <= max is required by the consumer; a single-value estimate is allowed only when accompanied by an explicit assumption.
